statement: ∀ (w : ℝ≥0∞) (A : Set ℝ) (t : ℝ), t ∈ unitI → Set.indicator (A ∩ unitI) (fun _ : ℝ => w) t = Set.indicator A (fun _ : ℝ => w) t
proof:
intro w A t ht
by_cases ha : t ∈ A
· simp [Set.indicator_of_mem, ha, ht]
· simp [Set.indicator_of_notMem, ha, ht]
